structural_matrix.checked: For 9 fixtures under both methods, the previous observer evaluates the original quoted antecedent, paired support or explicit routing, hard commitments, ranks and losses. It reconstructs all 18 complete terminal replies from the fixture definitions.
structural_matrix.sources: CF §§2–4; S fixtures, candidate_compile, ordinary_compile; O reconstruct_structural; R § Structural findings
structural_matrix.supplied_or_unchecked: The finite grammar, baseline, exceptions, weights, hard frames, action menu, loss meanings and copy/predictor routing are supplied. Correct evaluation does not infer the causal graph, justify relevance weights, or make a paired-support case an ordinary world or a truth probability.

structural_matrix.checked: The completed search/enumerator retains rank equality and the observer reconstructs every finite minimizer and loss image. The tied fixture retains both minima; the external-source fixture retains both sources despite minimum ranks 1 and 2.

structural_matrix.sources: CF C04-5–6; TR §2; S solve_candidate, solve_ordinary, choose_fixed_action; O reconstruct_structural
structural_matrix.supplied_or_unchecked: The declared domain and source roster exhaust the intended alternatives. Repair rank is minimized separately inside each source. These completions do not newly test interrupted-frontier coverage at arbitrary budgets, or justify discarding ties in another service.

structural_matrix.checked: Seven nonempty fixtures per method give 14 action warrants. Fixed falsity and impossible ordinary conditioning give 4 complete infeasibility replies and no useful action. The choice function refuses an action if any retained source lacks a nonempty target.
structural_matrix.hypothesis: Established nonempty target before an action warrant
structural_matrix.sources: CF §2 and C04-5–6; S choose_fixed_action; C units, default_config; R § Evidence and denominator
structural_matrix.supplied_or_unchecked: This is exhaustive infeasibility in the declared finite domain. An empty implication or an interrupted search without a witness cannot replace nonemptiness. The 60-unit roster does not add low-budget structural failure controls.

structural_matrix.checked: The selected action minimizes its maximum loss over all retained source/minimum pairs. Candidate and ordinary return the same action. The record explicitly refuses the hidden-case action oracle.
structural_matrix.hypothesis: Fixed minimax choice versus pointwise non-deterioration
structural_matrix.sources: CF §4 and C04-6; TR CT05-1; S choose_fixed_action; O reconstruct_structural
structural_matrix.supplied_or_unchecked: Minimax is the supplied consumer policy. Lower maximum absolute loss does not prove a nonpositive same-case loss difference against every alternative. A named baseline and a bound on that difference are needed for uniform non-deterioration; see the concrete example below.

structural_matrix.checked: No ADD current-bound receipt is produced by these 18 structural conformance calls. Their complete minimizer identities are a separate local service. The source roster calls run_method, not transport_development or the ADD receiving service.
structural_matrix.sources: ADD §§1–2.3; CF C04-5–6; C run; S run_method, transport_development
structural_matrix.supplied_or_unchecked: The separate receiving theorem needs a checked feasible incumbent w, the complete current request and D, and a checked bound on every feasible x with rank(x) <= rank(w), including nonoptimal points and ties. When B <= 0 and D is the intended fixed-pair loss difference, this implies non-deterioration on the minima. Minimizer-only answers do not establish the larger sublevel bound.

structural_matrix.checked: The fixture requests bind their complete current source and routing, and different routing masks give their declared outcomes. These 60 calls do not exercise an old-certificate admission, edit chain, domain-coverage bridge or repaired receipt.
structural_matrix.hypothesis: Reuse or repair after an edit (CT05-1, CT05-2, CT05-5)
structural_matrix.sources: TR §§2–3, 8; CF §7.2; S source_scope, fixtures; C run
structural_matrix.supplied_or_unchecked: Reuse needs valid old proof domains, a current feasible witness, a checked map into the old domain, the rank-drift/cutoff inequality, and a positive-unit numerical loss bridge covering every new minimum and unresolved source. A repaired allowance must still be <= 0 to warrant non-deterioration. Old winners, source names or a surviving candidate alone do not supply those premises.
